correctness.rationale: PASS: Minkowski support-range additivity counts mixed k-hyperedges across a centered cut as C(s)=binom(n,k)−binom(s,k)−binom(n−s,k). Every sorted zero-sum direction is a nonnegative linear combination of nested centered indicators, with exact support-range additivity and Euclidean triangle inequality, yielding global minimum over cuts and strict equality only for a single positive coordinate gap (all two-level normal ties included). For k_n/sqrt(n)→c>0, fixed-size cuts have normalized limit c sqrt(s), macroscopic cuts ≥2 with equality only balanced, and intermediate-size cuts diverge, proving min(c,2) and strict eventual singleton/balanced minimizing types off c=2. Independent n=3..8 hyperedge count/support evaluation corroborated finite formula.
